authorization.intent: Three scored attempts at max tier for the 12 Go-exclusive models (not available on Devin) under the main max-tier campaign's frozen settings (prompt-v2). Order: attempt 1 for the 8 models without one, then attempt 2 for all 12, then attempt 3. Infrastructure and quota failures do not count; they are rerun as linked retries.

held_models.rule: Available on Devin; held for later with run.py queue --hold. Their ordinals stay pending ('held'), are never probed or started, and are not failures. A later queue without --hold resumes them.

authorization.go_key_rule: Only OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY_3, one attempt at a time: key pool {OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY_3: 1}, workers 1, Go bound 1 in both manifests. The supervisor passes only Boat plus OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY_3 to the runners, so the exhausted base, _1 and _2 keys cannot be used. The controller-wide key lease serializes both queues on _3.
authorization.probe_rule: --key-gate-fresh-seconds 0: key _3 is probed with one tiny request ('Reply with OK.', max 16 tokens) before every start. A usage-limit probe stops starting: re-probe after 30 min (--probe-interval 1800), or 6 h when the reply names the weekly window. An attempt cut by a usage limit mid-run ends QUOTA (infrastructure), closes the key the same way and is requeued as a linked retry.
